note: Riverhills woodland, limestone bluffs, fields and small lakes between Columbia and Boonville. Camping is at the spots marked on the area map, each beside a gravel parking lot around the area's edge; this one is lot E on the east end of Route 442. Trailers must stay on the gravel parking areas. No privy or water. Spot length is not published. --Claude
summary: Confirmed MDC 'Designated Camping Sites'; brochure: 'Camping is allowed anytime in designated camping areas shown on map... Trailers are restricted to gravel parking areas', 14 days in 30. Free/FCFS/no hookups written manual. The 11/17/2021 map has 7 Primitive Camping symbols: lots B, C, D, E, F, G and one interior spot (#16, Lake Louie). Pin = GIS 283 beside lot E on Route 442 (GIS point ~10 m S of the lot, under trees). Splits proposed for the north lots (Routes 453/449) and the south lots (Highway 40). Phone differs: area page 573-445-3882. Not waterfront kept.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: area page lists 'Camping: Designated Camping Sites'. Brochure: 'Camping is allowed anytime in designated camping areas shown on map. These may or may not have defined campsites. Seasonal closures and restrictions may apply. Trailers are restricted to gravel parking areas... Campers are limited to 14 consecutive days in a 30-day period.' Each camping symbol on the map sits beside a lettered Parking Lot except #16 (interior, on a service road by a pond, no lot, so walk-in). Imagery: lots C, E and G are small gravel lots/aprons off the public roads in woods, enough for a 23-ft rig; the canopy hides their full size. No ford or 4WD wording.

CLUSTERS (7): E = pin, GIS 283/lot 184, 39.0044,-92.6156, east end of Route 442; #16 = GIS 344, 39.0001,-92.6273, 1.1 km SW, interior by Lake Louie (service road, no lot); G = GIS 343/lot 188, 38.9930,-92.6195, 1.3 km S, and F = GIS 285/lot 187, 38.9944,-92.6283, 1.6 km SW, both on the south edge by Highway 40 and the Katy Trail; D = GIS 345/lot 183, 39.0152,-92.6362, 2.1 km NW on the west part of Route 442; C = GIS 284/lot 185, 39.0299,-92.6105, 2.9 km N on Route 449; B = GIS 346/lot 186, 39.0357,-92.6297, 3.7 km NNW on Route 453.

SPLITS proposed (2), each its own public road 1.3 km+ from the pin: (a) 'Davisdale Conservation Area - North Camping Area' at 39.0298,-92.6104 (lot C on Route 449, east side), with lot B (39.0360,-92.6294, on Route 453, 1.7 km W of C) as a second spot; (b) 'Davisdale Conservation Area - Highway 40 Camping Area' at 38.9925,-92.6197 (lot G off Highway 40, the entrance the stored directions name), with lot F 760 m W. Both state/MDC, same groups, not waterfront. Lot D shares Route 442 with the pin, so no split for it.
PIN: stored 39.00437,-92.61553 = GIS camping point 283, ~10 m S of a pale gravel strip (lot 184) under trees on blurry imagery. Optional move onto the lot point, 39.0045,-92.6157.

PHONE: stored 573-815-7900 is the Columbia (Central Region) office on the 2021 brochure ('For local information, contact: ... 3500 E Gans Rd, Columbia ... (573) 815-7900'). The area page now reads 'For more information call (573) 445-3882'. Suggest 573-445-3882 (area page, current); apply.py doesn't write phones.
WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront, kept): the pin lot is in woods; Lake Louie and the other lakes are small ponds away from it, and the Missouri River is 1.5 miles off.
